validated: A complete synthetic Human Review Packet validates only when it contains research provenance, a precommitted discipline plan, explicit rule-conformance checks and a Human Decision Gate.
Human decision status defaults to UNSET at packet generation.
AUTO_BUY and equivalent executable states are rejected.
Capital-action-related packets without requires_human_decision=true are rejected.

An unsupported averaging-down/add-position scenario is representable only as ADD_POSITION_NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_FROZEN_RULES and preserves the original frozen plan.
A triggered exit condition can be surfaced prominently while order authority remains false.
An explicit user override can be recorded with a reason without rewriting the frozen plan.
